title: “I Would Have Written My Code Differently”: Beginners Struggle to Understand LLM-Generated Code

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing participant responses to buggy LLM-generated code to determine if they incorrectly assume the code is correct and predict outputs based on the intended behavior rather than the actual flawed code.
Comparing the success rates of prompt comprehension and code comprehension tasks between native English speakers and participants raised speaking other languages.

Testing for statistically significant performance differences in code comprehension tasks across self-reported demographic factors, including gender, race, and first-generation university student status.
